decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 6 April 2005, the retention of a detached single storey out building, providing playroom and shower/w.c, measuring 6.5 metres wide, 4.6 metres deep and 3.7 metres high to top of ridged roof  was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The development exceeds the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the use fails to represent an 'incidental purpose' as given in that Schedule and the building is not erected within the curtilage of the application site.

Condition : 2 - Informative: The applicant is advised that if a further Certificate is submitted it must incorporate legal proof that the land occupied by the building has been transferred to No. 2 Bulstrode Avenue.
description: Certificate of existing lawfulness for the retention of detached single storey playroom incorporating shower.w.c to rear of house.
